usedFor: Locate2u holds stops, trips and shipments, and Google AI Studio (Gemini) writes text through “Generate Content” when a status changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Shipment Status Change” in Locate2u, then “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini)
bestTemplate.why: A status change is a good moment to draft an update from a prompt you write.

watchOut: “Generate Content” works only from the prompt you write, so word it to suit each “Shipment Status Change”.
